lines.text: Six men with weapons of slaughter come from the direction of the Upper Gate and stand beside the bronze altar.
A man in linen carries a writing kit, and God's glory moves from above the cherubim to the temple threshold.
The LORD tells the man in linen to mark the foreheads of men groaning over the abominations.
God orders the others to spare only those with the mark, and they begin with the priests before the temple.
Ezekiel falls facedown and asks about the remnant, and God says the people claim the LORD has cleansed the land.
